For the camera component it uses country/dim (as mentioned to allow multiple cameras). The "delta" parameter is not in and can be safely edited without getting a new entity.

I cannot think of anything else to put into a unique id.

issue_context.title: weather.br_unknown_station doesnt change, and isn't editable
issue_context.body: ## The problem while before I used a name in the Buienradar weather integration, I decided to take that out, and hoped to get a weather.buienradar integration. Upon restart though the integration has made this weather.br_unknown_station, while at the same time its friendly_name is: BR Woensdrecht (6340) proving it does know which station it is using. I know about https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/buienradar/#name but the name isnt editable, nor does it change to the correct station. Which leaves the user no other way than use its core given name: ``` weather.br_unknown_station ``` in all other configuration files. Hardly a desirable situation. So, this comes across as a double bug: Imho, the integration really should have named the integration weather.buienradar, (like the other integrations giving the correct name to weather.openweathermap and weather.dark_sky), and use the station in its friendly_name. Of course, unless set in the name: configuration option. Which was purposely not used now. ## Environment - Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.111.4 - Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): never? - Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): Home Assistant - Integration causing this issue: Buienradar - Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/buienradar/ ## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` ```yaml weather: - platform: openweathermap api_key: !secret openweather_key mode: freedaily - platform: buienradar # name: !secret buienradar_station - platform: darksky api_key: !secret darksky_key mode: daily ``` ## Traceback/Error logs ```txt ``` ## Additional information see community post: https://community.home-assistant.io/t/new-integration-configured-weather-br-unknown-station/206017 What makes this even more contrived, is when explicitly using Buienradar for name with: ``` - platform: buienradar name: Buienradar ``` we do get a intended weather.buienradar integration name, but lose the friendly_name of the station we did have before. so: not using a name renders an integration name with 'unknown_station' in its entity_id, and use the correct station_name in its friendly_name using 'buienradar' as name, renders an intended integration name, but the station_name gets lost. Solution: have the weather integration use weather.buienradar, if no name has been configured, and set the station_name as friendly_name, (like it is now)

review_comments: This seem a bit iffy from an uniqueness perspective. There only ever exist one camera per country?

It is not blocked to have multiple cameras per country with different dimensions. I have no idea how it is being used, so that's why at least I took it into the unique id, to be sure not to break anything.
You're right, I used to have 3 buienradar cameras for different regions in the country. Not sure if that is still possible (dont use them now) but would be great if it wasn't blocked/broken.

So leave as is? My main problem with removing it is creating a breaking change, which I wouldn't want to do with such a small pr.

A breaking change is anyway coming with the config flow so it's better to address it there.
